title: Redstone Lectern
description:
Optimized for Redstone:     
with a permanently attached 15 page book, visible page numbers, and click to turn pages
body:
![title image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39e77d0b81431d989625a3d7c857d2cd620ef41a.png) # THE REDSTONE LECTERN **This mod adds a new lectern variant that is optimized for redstone**
**The Redstone Lectern has a permanently attached 15 page book** - The page number is displayed on the page - Click to turn the page, with no interface - Pick Block captures the page number - Can be moved by pistons

Also: - Not a block entity, unlike the vanilla lectern - No redstone pulse on page turn - Craftable like a vanilla lectern plus a book - Does not replace the vanilla lectern


This concept was inspired by Vanilla Tweaks and Redstone Tweaks, thanks!
